content: विक्षेपः .²1 Throwing away or asunder, scattering about. .²2 Casting, throwing, discharging (<ab>opp.</ab> संहार); संहारविक्षेपसहस्रकोटीस्तिष्ठन्ति जीवाः <ls>Mb. 12. 280. 30</ls>; संहारविक्षेपलघुक्रियेण <ls>R. 5. 45</ls>. .²3 Waving, moving about, shaking, moving to and fro; बाहुविक्षेपकरणां समुद्यम्य महागदाम् <ls>Rām. 7. 32. 41</ls>. लाङ्गूल˚ <ls>Ku. 1. 13</ls>. .²4 Sending, despatching. .²5 Distraction, confusion, perplexity; <ls>Māl. 1</ls>. .²6 Alarm, fear. .²7 Refutation of an argument. .²8 Polar latitude. .²9 Looking about vaguely or wildly. .²10 Neglecting (time). .²11 Extension, projection. .²12 A kind of weapon.
